newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Tibet region economy grows 10 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China's Tibet region economy grows 10 pct in 1996.

text.p: Gross regional output of China's remote southwestern Tibet region grew 10 percent in 1996 to hit 6.45 billion yuan ($777 million), the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Tibet harvested 779,000 tonnes of grain last year while industrial ouput in the region, which is populated mostly by herders and farmers, rose 14.4 percent, the agency said, quoting regional government statistics.
Foreign trade in the impoverished Himalayan area soared by 65.2 percent to more than $100 million, it said.
Passenger transport volume rose 25 percent compared with the year before, while cargo transport volume jumped 27 percent, it said but gave no further details.
